Qur'anic quotation: ﴿وَنَفْسٍ﴾ "and by a soul" 

Translation:

﴿And a soul﴾ meaning souls (nufus, plural of nafs). ﴿And He who proportioned it﴾ in its creation. The mā (ما) in the three places is either a verbal-noun particle (maṣdariyyah), or it means "the One who" (man).

﴿So He inspired it [with] its wickedness and its righteousness.﴾ He showed it the path of good and the path of evil. He placed righteousness (taqwa) later for the sake of the rhyme of the verse-endings (ru'us al-ayat) and for the response to the oath (jawab al-qasam), which is: "﴿He has certainly succeeded...﴾" (qad aflaha).
﴿Indeed, he has succeeded﴾ The lam (ل) was omitted from it because of the length of the speech. ﴿He who purifies it﴾ means he purified it (زَكّاها) from sins.

﴿And he has certainly failed﴾ lost, ﴿who suppresses it﴾ conceals it by disobedience. Its original form was دَسَّسَها (dassasahā), and the second sin was changed into an alif for lightening (تَخْفِيفًا, takhfīfan).

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 91, verse 11:

﴿Thamud denied﴾ their messenger Salih, ﴿in their rebellion﴾, that is, because of their transgression.

Tafsir al-Jalalayn on Surah 91 (ash-Shams), verse 12:

﴿Idh-ub'atha﴾ (when he rushed forth), meaning he hastened, ﴿ashqāhā﴾ (the most wretched of them), and his name was Qudār, to hamstring the she-camel, with their consent.

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 91, verse 13:

﴿So the Messenger of Allah said to them﴾ — Ṣāliḥ — ﴿"The she-camel of Allah"﴾ — i.e., leave her — ﴿"and her drinking"﴾ — her drinking in her day; she had a day, and they had a day.

Translation:

﴿So they denied him﴾ in his saying that, from God, upon which the descent of punishment upon them was contingent if they opposed him. ﴿Then they hamstrung her﴾ they killed her, so that the water of her drinking would be theirs alone. ﴿Then He sent down destruction upon them﴾ meaning He closed over them, ﴿their Lord, for their sin﴾ the punishment. ﴿And levelled it over them﴾ meaning the destruction upon them, that is, He encompassed them with it, so that not one of them escaped.
﴿And not﴾ — read with the waw (وَ) and the fa' (فَ), ﴿he fears not its consequence﴾: its sequel (تَبِعَتها).
